description: 【南山城村】公衆無線LAN(wifi) [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 南山城村. 平成29年度公衆無線LAN環境整備支援事業により、南山城村の防災拠点（避難所・避難場所・官公署）及び被災場所として想定され災害対応の強化が望まれる公的拠点（観光案内所、文化財、自然公園等）へ公衆無線LAN（Wi-Fi)環境の整備を行ったものです。. Coverage: 南山城村. The portal files it under the publisher 南山城村. Its tags are 推奨データセット, 防災_安全安心. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2021-10-27 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
